verdict.rationale: Poly documents that new journal entries are stored as Markdown files synced to the Mind folder. The desktop app also exposes Poly files as a real folder in Finder or Explorer that syncs back automatically, so notes sit on disk in an open format the user controls. Finder tags also sync bidirectionally, so some organizational metadata stays portable. missing for 10: explicit export feature or documented JSON export for metadata/memory, confirmation that notes imported from Notion/Obsidian/etc. are stored as Markdown, independent or hands-on corroboration.
